title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: glazing and balustrades
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Corporate box glass balustrades
swms.task: Install glass balustrades at the front edge of the corporate boxes, lifting glass panels with vacuum lifters, and sealing with silicone.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the silicone sealant are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves.
facts.fallControl: Workers at the open box edge use a travel restraint system to engineer designed anchors installed by a competent person, so they cannot reach the edge.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.harnessSystem: Workers wear a full body harness with a restraint lanyard of 1.5 m, set so they cannot reach the edge, clipped to anchors on the box slab installed and rated by the anchor installer. Harnesses and lanyards are checked by the user before each use and inspected by a competent person every 6 months, recorded on the tag. Users are trained in working at heights by a registered training organisation.
